west_companion.title: West Launcher
west_companion.subtitle: Find your way.
west_companion.compat: Compatibility mode: %s detected, main menu untouched
west_companion.fullbright.server_warning: [West] FullBright is on — some servers may forbid it. Press Right Shift to turn it off.
west_companion.pvp.title: 1v1 vs Ashi
west_companion.pvp.subtitle: Pick a kit and fight Ashi; the coach watches every round.
west_companion.pvp.kit.sword.desc: Pure sword: hit timing, crits and sprint hits.
west_companion.pvp.kit.axe.desc: Raise your shield at the right time; break Ashi's with the axe.
west_companion.pvp.kit.gapple.desc: Back off, eat gapples at the right time, pressure while they eat.
west_companion.pvp.kit.pot.desc: Fight with Speed II; splash healing at your feet.
west_companion.pvp.safety: A temporary sky arena is built. Your items, health, position and game mode are saved and restored exactly when the match ends. Nobody really dies.
west_companion.pvp.singleplayer_only: 1v1 only works in a singleplayer world (not opened to LAN).
west_companion.pvp.aborted: [West] Duel ended; your items and position were restored.
west_companion.pvp.recovered: [West] Restored your items and position from an unfinished duel.
west_companion.pvp.error.busy: [West] Can't start a duel right now (sleeping or riding?).
west_companion.pvp.error.start: [West] Couldn't start the duel; nothing was changed.
west_companion.pvp.match_won: You won! Ashi says well played.
west_companion.coach.intro.sword: Sword round! Hit when the cooldown is full; hit while falling from a jump for a crit.
west_companion.coach.intro.axe: Raise your shield right before Ashi swings (right click). You can break my shield with the axe!
west_companion.coach.intro.gapple: When low, back off and eat a golden apple. Rush me while I eat!
west_companion.coach.intro.pot: You have Speed II. When low, look down and splash a potion at your feet.
west_companion.coach.spam: Don't spam: hitting before the cooldown fills does far less damage.
west_companion.coach.crit: Jump and hit while falling: crits deal 1.5x damage.
west_companion.coach.sprint: Hit while sprinting (hold Ctrl): sprint hits knock back and start combos.
west_companion.coach.combo_taken: You're getting comboed! Strafe (A/D), make space and hit back when ready.
west_companion.coach.heal_gapple: Low health: back off and eat a golden apple.
west_companion.coach.heal_pot: Low health: look down and splash a potion at your feet (right click).
west_companion.coach.ashi_gapple: Ashi is eating a gapple — pressure them!
west_companion.coach.ashi_pot: Ashi threw a pot; punish while they heal.
west_companion.coach.use_axe: Ashi is blocking. Switch to the axe: it disables shields for 5 seconds.
west_companion.coach.shield_broken: Shield broken! Switch to the sword and push.
west_companion.coach.good_block: Good block! Only raise your shield when Ashi is about to swing.
west_companion.coach.aim: Lots of misses: keep your crosshair on their body and swing once in range.
west_companion.coach.keep_going: Your technique looks clean. Try the next difficulty!
